product_brief: A C library for Post-Quantum Cryptographic (PQC) signature algorithms for Bitcoin, implementing ML-DSA-44, SLH-DSA, and BIP 340 Schnorr.
pqc_capability_description: Implements two NIST-standardized PQC signature algorithms: ML-DSA-44 (FIPS 204, lattice-based) and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (FIPS 205, stateless hash-based). Also supports BIP 340 Schnorr (secp256k1). The implementations are based on reference code from the NIST PQC standardization process and are explicitly stated as "not production-hardened." It provides key generation, signing, and verification functions with a unified C API.
key_management_model: User-provided entropy (bring your own randomness); library does not provide its own random number generation.
fips_validated: No (The text states the algorithms are "FIPS-certified" referring to the standards FIPS 204 and FIPS 205, but the library itself is based on reference code and is "not production-hardened," implying the library implementation is not FIPS 140 validated).
primary_platforms: Unknown (Mentions Nix, CMake, C99 compiler, but no specific OS deployment targets)
testing_&_validation_methods: Registered tests cover BIP 340 golden vectors, ML-DSA-44 keygen/sign/verify/tamper rejection, and SLH-DSA golden vectors/determinism/verify/reject paths. Includes short entropy rejection and NULL argument rejection tests.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Unknown (Library requires user-provided entropy from a cryptographically secure source; does not provide its own RNG).
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Dependencies include sphincsplus and pq-crystals/dilithium reference implementations.
